environment: Chromium 144, headed under Xvfb, ANGLE SwiftShader software WebGL2
execution: Actual standalone HTML injected with Playwright set_content; URL and file navigation are blocked by environment policy. No WebGL mocking.

results.name: Actual WebGL2 renderer and exact Three.js r140 runtime
144 file buildings rendered as an InstancedMesh
Unselected city uses 16 scene draw calls
On-demand renderer is idle without input
File-list selection does not move camera
Explicit Focus in city changes the camera
Closing and reopening Details preserves selection and pose
Search dims in place and retains out-of-filter selection
Zero matches does not erase geometry or the snapshot
Escape in search clears only the query
Enter in search selects the first match without focus movement
File-kind filter synchronizes list, city, and selection warning
Top view restores the full prior 3D camera bookmark
Pointer selection is driven by actual Three.js raycasting
Primary drag orbits without accidental selection
Shift-drag pans instead of orbiting
Wheel zoom works over the focused canvas
Canvas shortcuts and scoped search shortcut work
Typing into search does not trigger camera shortcuts
Changing height metric preserves camera state
Label and shadow switches control real scene state
HTML inventory shares selection and suspends drawing
Light and dark themes update both UI and WebGL scene
Malformed JSON import retains the previous snapshot
Raw fallow output is explicitly rejected without an adapter
JSON file input imports actual custom snapshot data
Unicode search and unknown-versus-zero measurements are distinct
Imported markup is displayed as text, not executed
Empty snapshot renders an explicit empty state
Repeated snapshot loads do not grow geometry allocations
Actual WebGL context loss and restoration preserve data and selection
Narrow layout retains controls without document overflow
5,000 files render with bounded HTML list population
Real scene capture returns PNG image data
No script errors during interaction checks
Standalone artifact makes no network requests
Viewer disposal stops work and removes labels
